hints.lin.graphing.points: (x, y): x first, across (right for positive, left for negative); then y, up or down.
hints.lin.graphing.line: Start at b on the y-axis. Then use the slope: rise over run (go right by the run, up or down by the rise). Tap those two points.
hints.lin.graphing: Points: across first, then up or down. Lines: start at b, then rise over run.

misconceptionMessages.lin.plot-swapped: x comes first: go across first, then up or down. (3, −2) is right 3, down 2.
misconceptionMessages.lin.plot-sign: Check the signs: negative x goes left, negative y goes down.

similarProblemIntro: Here's the worked solution. Now try one like it.

sections.title: Plot points
sections.objective: Plot points like (3, −2) on the coordinate grid.
explain: The grid has two number lines: x goes across, y goes up and down. They cross at (0, 0).
A point (x, y) tells you how far across, then how far up or down.
sections.key: (x, y): start at (0, 0). Go across by x (right if positive, left if negative), then up or down by y.

sections.title: Graph a line
sections.objective: Graph y = mx + b: start at b, then rise over run.
explain: y = mx + b gives a starting point and directions. b is where the line crosses the y-axis.
From there, the slope m says how to get to the next point: rise over run.

visual.caption: y = 2x − 3: start at −3, then right 1, up 2.

sections.key: Start at (0, b) on the y-axis. Then go right by the run and up (or down) by the rise. Two points make the line.

sections.title: Putting it together
sections.objective: Plotting points and graphing lines, mixed.
sections.key: Points: across, then up or down. Lines: start at b on the y-axis, then rise over run.
